notes.title: "Special Forces War - Zombie Attack" is now officially online
notes.content:
[h3] "Special Forces War - Zombie Attack" is now officially online! ! ! [/h3]

A very fun and interesting casual strategy tower defense game, full of fun, I hope it can bring you different fun~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44738390/7cab9e4bb4dd935f5d362adc811b5f08dd45139b.png[/img]

Official chat group: https://steamcommunity.com

notes.title: The official version is scheduled for November 29th
notes.content:
Thanks to all players for your continued attention and support, "Special Forces War - Zombie Attack" will officially meet with you on November 29, 2023.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44738390/aedfdba02f3294b064aefbd5f23368850f0bd7b4.png[/img]

notes.title: Nice to meet you!
notes.content:
Awaited! Finally, "Special Forces War - Zombie Attack" officially meets everyone, and it is announced that the game will be officially launched in Q4 2023!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44738390/7cab9e4bb4dd935f5d362adc811b5f08dd45139b.png[/img]
Thank you for your continued attention and support. We will work harder to polish the game, and please look forward to the official launch of "Special Forces War - Zombie Attack"!

Official chat group:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/chat/invite/kKKH5Wa9]https://steamcommunity.com[/url]
